question: Are the action-level interface data already source-locked well enough to combine the s6fZ2 field-space gauge template with the independent projectable gravitational parent before a full coupled Dirac count?
required_interface_data: projectable lapse convention shared by both sectors
representation/charge assignment of phi and chi under every gravitational-parent local gauge symmetry
definition of D_perp Phi using the same lapse/shift variables or invariant shift used by the gravitational parent
closure/commutator of field-space and gravitational gauge transformations on all shared variables
same-action lapse and shift dependence of the scalar sector
no coefficient selected from soft-s or k=0.03 outputs

decision_rule.INTERFACE_READY_PASS_SCOPED: All required representation and shared lapse/shift data are explicitly source-locked.
decision_rule.INTERFACE_UNDERDETERMINED_PASS_SCOPED: The parent sectors are independently motivated but at least one representation/shared-variable datum required for a combined action is not source-locked; identify it explicitly without inventing a choice.
